hints.title: Split the work into stages
hints.body: The final order takes nodes from the front and from the back alternately. If the back half were reversed, the problem would become a simple interleaving of two lists.

hints.title: Find the midpoint
hints.body: Use one slow pointer and one fast pointer. When the fast pointer reaches the end, the slow pointer is at the end of the first half.

hints.title: Reverse and interleave
hints.body: Cut the chain after the midpoint, reverse the second half, then merge the two halves one node at a time.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
if the list has fewer than two nodes: return head
find the last node of the first half with slow and fast pointers
second = slow.next
slow.next = null
reverse second
first = head
while second is not empty:
    firstNext = first.next
    secondNext = second.next
    first.next = second
    second.next = firstNext
    first = firstNext
    second = secondNext
return head
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
